In this research, we wanted to find out how people's thoughts and feelings (self-perceptions) affect their physical health. We hypothesized that people with more negative thoughts about themselves would have poorer health than people who were self-confident.

## Conclusion

Our hypothesis was supported by our research findings. Participants who rated themselves higher in self-esteem showed better physical health than those who rated themselves lower in self-esteem.

## Research Findings

Our research findings indicated that self-perceptions had a significant effect on physical health.
